name: Flame Fruit
description: Transforms the user into living flame. Devastating AoE clears and a long-range fireball, balanced by mediocre sword combos.

abilities.name: Fire Fist
abilities.desc: Hurl a piercing column of flame in a straight line.

abilities.name: Flame Pillar
abilities.desc: Erupt a tall pillar of fire at your cursor that lingers and burns.

abilities.name: Phoenix Dash
abilities.desc: Stream forward as living flame, dealing tick damage on contact.

abilities.name: Hell's Crucible
abilities.desc: Detonate a wide explosion around you. Best opener after a stun.

tips: Open fights with X to zone, then Z while target is locked in the pillar.
Avoid using V at low energy — the cast time leaves you exposed.
Pair with Electro for the burn-shock ramp combo.

name: Ice Fruit
description: Freeze the air, the sea, and your enemies. Strong crowd control with a defensive ice wall.

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.desc: Fire a quick freezing spear that briefly slows on hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Path
abilities.desc: Skate on a path of ice — high mobility, low damage.

abilities.name: Glacial Wall
abilities.desc: Raise a wall of ice in front of you. Blocks projectiles.

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.desc: Freeze every target in a wide radius for 1.5s.

tips: Use C to body-block ranged DPS while your team closes the gap.
V is a guaranteed setup for sword finishers.

name: Magma Fruit
description: Slow but absurdly heavy DPS. Magma applies a long burn that ticks through most defensive abilities.

abilities.name: Magma Fist
abilities.desc: Lob a slow molten orb that explodes on impact.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.desc: Pillars of magma rise across a small zone.

abilities.name: Hound's Howl
abilities.desc: Charge forward as a magma hound, burning targets through.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.desc: Call a meteor down on your cursor. Massive splash.

tips: Counter to Flame Fruit — magma burns through fire intangibility.

name: Light Fruit
description: Move at the speed of light. Hyper-mobile assassin with hitscan beams.

abilities.name: Light Beam
abilities.desc: Hitscan laser. Cannot be dodged at close range.

abilities.name: Yasakani
abilities.desc: Spray a cone of light bolts.

abilities.name: Lightspeed Kick
abilities.desc: Teleport-dash to your cursor and strike.

abilities.name: Sacred Yata
abilities.desc: Channel a wide laser sweep for 2s.

name: Dark Fruit
description: Suppresses enemy fruits on contact. The hard-counter to Logia spam.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: Pull enemies in a cone toward you.

abilities.name: Liberation
abilities.desc: Release stored matter as a damaging blast.

abilities.name: Grip
abilities.desc: Latch onto a target — disables their fruit briefly.

abilities.name: Annihilate
abilities.desc: Collapse a sphere of darkness around your cursor.

tips: C cancels enemy ultimates if you land it during their cast.

name: Rubber Fruit
description: Stretchy, bouncy combos. Low ceiling but excellent for new players learning M1 spacing.

abilities.name: Pistol
abilities.desc: Quick punch with extended reach.

abilities.name: Bazooka
abilities.desc: Two-handed launch that knocks targets back.

abilities.name: Gum Rocket
abilities.desc: Slingshot yourself to a wall or enemy.

abilities.name: Gear Surge
abilities.desc: Buff M1 damage and speed for 8s.

name: String Fruit
description: Puppet-master kit: pull, slice, and lock down with razor strings.

abilities.name: Slash Threads
abilities.desc: Whip strings outward in a wide arc.

abilities.name: Puppet
abilities.desc: Hook a target and reposition them toward you.

abilities.name: Cage
abilities.desc: Trap targets in a string box for 2s.

abilities.name: Birdcage
abilities.desc: Encircle the area in slowly contracting strings.

name: Sand Fruit
description: Drains stamina and bleeds water from anything you touch. Strong sustain on desert maps.

abilities.name: Desert Spear
abilities.desc: Compressed sand spear thrown forward.

abilities.name: Sandstorm
abilities.desc: Channel a tornado at your cursor.

abilities.name: Quicksand
abilities.desc: Convert ground into sand — slows enemies.

abilities.name: Desert Sun
abilities.desc: Burst of compressed sand that desiccates targets.

name: Rumble Fruit
description: Hitscan thunder strikes and a global ult. Mid-tier solo, top-tier in raids.

abilities.name: Thunder Bolt
abilities.desc: Strike a single target with lightning.

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.desc: Place a cloud that drops chained bolts.

abilities.name: Volt Step
abilities.desc: Teleport-dash a short distance.

abilities.name: 200 Million Volt
abilities.desc: Concentrated beam from above. Deals true damage.

name: Smoke Fruit
description: Beginner-friendly Logia. Easy intangibility and a long-range pull.

abilities.name: White Out
abilities.desc: Cone of smoke that briefly blinds.

abilities.name: Smoke Drag
abilities.desc: Tendril yanks one target toward you.

abilities.name: Smoke Glide
abilities.desc: Hover-dash on a smoke trail.

abilities.name: Smoke Cyclone
abilities.desc: Spin a tornado of smoke around you.

name: Phoenix Fruit
description: Hybrid healer/duelist. Flight, AoE healing flames, sustained DPS — rare and expensive.

abilities.name: Talon
abilities.desc: Diving slash that closes distance.

abilities.name: Healing Flame
abilities.desc: Pulse blue fire that heals allies.

abilities.name: Wing Storm
abilities.desc: Flap to launch wide feather blades.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.desc: Revive once on death within 12s.

name: Buddha Fruit
description: Massive HP scaling and giant golden form. Walking siege piece.

abilities.name: Palm Strike
abilities.desc: Wide-arc shockwave palm.

abilities.name: Giant Form
abilities.desc: Grow huge for 10s — armor + damage.

abilities.name: Holy Lance
abilities.desc: Project a lance of light.

abilities.name: Heaven's Judgment
abilities.desc: Slam down with both palms — quake shockwave.

name: Quake Fruit
description: Considered the strongest Paramecia in existence. Every punch sends out world-cracking shockwaves that bypass guard.

abilities.name: Quake Punch
abilities.desc: Single shockwave that pierces through everything in a line.

abilities.name: Sea Quake
abilities.desc: Slam the ground — radial shockwave knocks all nearby foes back.

abilities.name: Air Tremor
abilities.desc: Crack the air itself, launching a delayed mid-air explosion.

abilities.name: Continental Shatter
abilities.desc: Channel for 1s, then unleash an unblockable city-wide quake.

tips: Z is the most reliable single-target shockwave in the game — spam it on bosses.
V is a guaranteed kill on most non-mythical mobs.

name: Gravity Fruit
description: Bend gravity itself. Pin enemies to the ground, drop meteors, or float yourself out of every danger zone.

abilities.name: Gravity Push
abilities.desc: Cone-shaped shove that flings light foes far back.

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.desc: Slam a single target into the ground for heavy damage.

abilities.name: Float
abilities.desc: Levitate for 6s — immune to ground-based attacks.

abilities.name: Meteor Shower
abilities.desc: Pull six meteors down on the cursor area over 3s.

name: Soul Fruit
description: Steal life force directly. Drain HP from enemies on hit and reanimate fallen mobs as temporary allies.

abilities.name: Soul Pocus
abilities.desc: Strike that drains 25% of your damage as healing.

abilities.name: Animate
abilities.desc: Reanimate the last killed mob to fight for 8s.

abilities.name: Lifeline
abilities.desc: Channel — heal yourself rapidly while immobile.

abilities.name: Soul Reaping
abilities.desc: Mass drain — strip HP from every enemy in range.

tips: Soul mains never die in extended fights. Pair with Cyborg race for limit-break sustain.

name: Operation Fruit
description: Surgeon's domain. Inside your operating room you control space — swap places, slice through cover, and stitch wounds.

abilities.name: Scalpel
abilities.desc: Quick clean cut with bonus crit chance inside ROOM.

abilities.name: Shambles
abilities.desc: Swap positions with the highest-HP enemy in range.

abilities.name: Counter Shock
abilities.desc: Touch a target — burst damage and brief stun.

abilities.name: Gamma Knife
abilities.desc: Surgical strike that ignores 50% of enemy defense.

tips: X is great for repositioning yourself out of danger while bringing the boss in close.

name: Spider Fruit
description: Mythical Zoan — eight-legged ambush form. Webs slow, restrict, and detonate.

abilities.name: Web Shot
abilities.desc: Sticky projectile that roots target in place.

abilities.name: Crawl
abilities.desc: Stick to walls and ceilings for 8s.

abilities.name: Venom Bite
abilities.desc: Chunk damage + 5s poison stack.

abilities.name: Web Trap
abilities.desc: Lay a web that detonates when triggered.

name: Dough Fruit
description: Sticky, stretchy, and impossibly resilient. Weaponize confectionary into massive fists.

abilities.name: Mochi Pistol
abilities.desc: Stretchy fist with insane reach.

abilities.name: Power Mochi
abilities.desc: Become temporarily invulnerable for 4s.

abilities.name: Sticky Trap
abilities.desc: Drop a mochi pool that slows enemies stepping on it.

abilities.name: Sweet Punch
abilities.desc: Wind up a colossal fist — biggest single hit in the game.

name: Venom Fruit
description: Generate and control poisonous gas. Damage-over-time specialist that thrives in long fights.

abilities.name: Poison Spit
abilities.desc: Quick poison projectile that applies a 6s DoT.

abilities.name: Toxic Cloud
abilities.desc: Place a lingering poison fog at cursor.

abilities.name: Hydra
abilities.desc: Three-headed poison snake strikes outward.

name: Shadow Fruit
description: Steal shadows to summon ghost copies. Loved by solo grinders for the autonomous shadow soldiers.

abilities.name: Shadow Bullet
abilities.desc: Compressed shadow shot.

abilities.name: Shadow Steal
abilities.desc: Steal an enemy's shadow — they lose 20% damage for 8s.

abilities.name: Doppelganger
abilities.desc: Spawn a shadow clone that mimics your strikes for 6s.

name: Storm Fruit
description: Command the cyclones of the Grand Line. Better at clearing groups than singletons.

abilities.name: Gale Burst
abilities.desc: Sharp gust that pushes targets back.

abilities.name: Funnel Cloud
abilities.desc: Plant a tornado that drags mobs into it.

abilities.name: Ride the Wind
abilities.desc: Become wind for 4s — un-targetable.

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.desc: Massive cyclone — wipes weak mobs across half the screen.

name: Barrier Fruit
description: Project unbreakable walls. Annoying in PvP, broken in raids — your party never dies.

abilities.name: Barrier Slam
abilities.desc: Wall that slams forward like a piston.

abilities.name: Cage
abilities.desc: Trap a target in a 2s box.

abilities.name: Bunker
abilities.desc: Self-bubble — invulnerable for 3s.

name: Time Fruit
description: Bend the flow of time itself. Slow your enemies, rewind your wounds, freeze the world for one perfect strike.

abilities.name: Slow Field
abilities.desc: Cone-slows enemies by 50% for 4s.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.desc: Heal yourself back to your HP from 5s ago.

abilities.name: Stop
abilities.desc: Freeze the world for 1.2s — every strike during it is a guaranteed crit.

abilities.name: Chronoshatter
abilities.desc: Collapse time on a single target — a single guaranteed-lethal blow.

name: Celestial Dragon Fruit
description: The fruit said to be eaten only by gods. Once per millennium, the seas surrender one — and only one. Massive scaling, every stat raised, every enemy diminished.

abilities.name: Halo Strike
abilities.desc: Holy beam that ignores all defenses.

abilities.name: Divine Form
abilities.desc: Transform — every stat doubles for 12s.

abilities.name: Wrath of Stars
abilities.desc: Pull seven star-fragments down on cursor area.

abilities.name: Genesis
abilities.desc: Recreate the battlefield. Wipes everything in range and refunds half their HP as Beli.

name: Void Fruit
description: Eat the void itself. Erase what should not be — even bosses, even time, even mistakes. Considered impossible to actually consume.

abilities.name: Erase
abilities.desc: Single-target deletion — bypasses 75% of HP scaling.

abilities.name: Negate
abilities.desc: Cancel the next enemy attack/cast within 6s.

abilities.name: Become Nothing
abilities.desc: Become unmistakeably absent. Untargetable for 5s.

abilities.name: Endpoint
abilities.desc: Channel — the world holds its breath for 2.5s. Then the target ceases. Always lethal.
